jobs.description:
From June 1, 2026 or by arrangement
 The 4-star-plus Resort Hof Weissbad enjoys an excellent reputation as an innovative and successful company. In one of the most beautiful resorts in Eastern Switzerland, you will find not only a warm team spirit but also attractive employment conditions. We owe our success to our approximately 270 friendly and motivated employees.
 These are your tasks

• Independent care, support, and accompaniment of inpatient patients

• Professional execution of nursing measures within your own area of competence

• Responsible implementation of daily personal care and support of patients in daily life activities

• Recognizing changes and emergency situations, acting appropriately, and initiating necessary measures

• Taking over administrative and organizational tasks in everyday nursing
 What we expect from you

• Completed training as a Health Specialist EFZ or equivalent foreign training with SRK recognition or positive PreCheck

• Professional, empathetic demeanor, neat appearance, and very good manners

• Enjoyment in working with people and strong service orientation

• Internalized professional standards regarding hygiene, cleanliness, and structured work

• Team player and communicative personality

• Good observation skills, quick understanding of situations, and responsible actions

• Resilience and calmness even in demanding or hectic situations

• Willingness to work weekend shifts and flexible deployment for holiday cover
 What we offer you

• Catering : our kitchen also conjures up fresh, healthy, and subsidized meals for our employees

• Health : to stay fit and healthy, our employees use the bathing and fitness area free of charge

• Promotion : we support your professional development through cost-sharing for further training

• Discounts : you benefit from discounts in our hotel, in the region, as well as with partner companies of the ERFA group and the Private Selection Hotels

• Additional benefits : weekend bonuses and free parking
